Uber enhances safety features in India with new ride recording and ambulance support

Ride-sharing company Uber has launched new safety features in India, including in-app video recording of rides and direct access to ambulance services. These initiatives were announced during Uber India's safety conference, which was attended by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari. The company aims to improve emergency response and overall passenger safety.
